checkMessages: A disposable XamlPackage opens in the production editor.
Font weight command formats the selected text.
Font size command formats the selected text.
Clear formatting resets the selected font.
Alignment, first-line indent and line spacing commands apply.
Bulleted list command wraps the paragraph.
Clear list command restores a paragraph.
Changing an ink slot and applying it are separate commands.
Copy places the selected disposable text on the clipboard.
Cut removes the selected disposable text.
Remove empty paragraphs command removes empty paragraphs.
Link dialog inserts the requested HTTP hyperlink.
Cancelling the link dialog preserves content.
Embedded image width changes with its aspect ratio.
Remove image removes the embedded image, not its source file.
Removing an embedded image preserves its source file.
A caret in one rectangular table cell enables structure commands.
Merged cells disable table structure commands.
Add bookmark creates an anchor at the caret.
Rename bookmark updates its visible name.
Bookmark link is available at a valid paragraph caret.
Insert bookmark link creates an internal destination.
Bookmark index rebuild retains the live anchor.
Structure tree contains the current document.
The production structure tree is visible in Home.
The production paginated preview is visible.
Reading mode disables structure navigation and editing.
Fit page command applies in reading mode.
Background image picker applies the disposable image.
Declining crop finalization preserves the file and dirty document.
Successful Save finalizes the background crop.
Remove background restores a solid background.
XamlPackage reopening retains the finalized background.
XamlPackage reopening retains table and hyperlinks.
XamlPackage reopening retains the embedded image.
Syntax article retains all forty legacy examples.
All thirty-five syntax and limitation examples render without invoking external navigation.
Markdown opens separately from the ordinary document.
Markdown source keeps CRLF and syntax.
Markdown preview renders a table from source.
Markdown preview loads the relative local image.
Markdown Save preserves BOM, source and CRLF.
Markdown help opens md.syntax in a separate window and preserves source and main navigation.
Opening Markdown help preserves inactive document path and revisions.
Returning from Markdown help retains the exact ordinary document, its text and background.
Returning to Markdown preserves its source.
captureMethod: RenderTargetBitmap of visible production WPF windows
interaction: visible production control DataContexts and commands; real link/crop dialogs; production image/layout/crop services; image paths and unsaved decisions supplied by queues; disposable clipboard roundtrip with prior data object restored in memory
limitations: No physical keyboard/mouse, drag gesture, installed-user migration or Windows scaling test. Image resize/layout/crop services and routed image selection are exercised; the native image picker is replaced by a disposable path queue. See image-undo.json and bookmark-roundtrip.json for observed product limitations.
